metadata.query:
fetch user.events, from:-10d
| expand app = dt.rum.application.entities
| filter dt.rum.user_type == "real_user"
| fieldsAdd fapp = if(startsWith(page.detected_name, "/en/labs"), "labs",
                   else: if(startsWith(page.detected_name, "/en/frontier/app-react"), "app-react",
                   else: "other"))
| filter fapp != "other"
| fieldsAdd day = bin(start_time, 1d)
| summarize { sessions = countDistinctExact(dt.rum.session.id), events = count() },
    by:{app, fapp, day}
| sort day asc
metadata.canonicalQuery:
fetch user.events, from:-10d
| expand app = dt.rum.application.entities
| filter dt.rum.user_type == "real_user"
| fieldsAdd fapp = if(startsWith(page.detected_name, "/en/labs"), "labs", else:if(startsWith(page.detected_name, "/en/frontier/app-react"), "app-react", else:"other"))
| filter fapp != "other"
| fieldsAdd day = bin(start_time, 24h)
| summarize by:{app, fapp, day}, {sessions = countDistinctExact(dt.rum.session.id), events = count()}
| sort day
